title: Data Analyst
description:
Data Analyst
Location: Southampton (On-site only at Fawley)
Assignment Period: Temporary (1 year), with potential for extension
Hours: 37.5 hrs/week
Salary Range: £48,400 - £85,000 (dependent on experience)

Our client, a reputable organisation, is hiring for a talented Data Analyst to join their team in Southampton. This is an exciting opportunity to work on meaningful projects, analysing complex data to drive strategic decisions.

What you'll be doing:
* Import, cleanse, validate, and analyse data from SAP, Microsoft Office, and Power BI environments.
* Draw insights, conclusions, and actionable recommendations from data sets.
* Create clear, concise management-level presentations using charts, graphs, and tables.
* Focus on improving data quality and consistency across systems.
* Collaborate with departments and management to identify trends, correlations, and patterns.
* Provide supervision, training, and mentorship to junior analysts.

What you'll bring:
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office, Power BI, and data management tools.
* Ability to produce insightful reports and presentations.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams and managing multiple priorities.

This role offers a fantastic chance to contribute to organisational success through data-driven insights. If you are passionate about turning data into strategic value, we'd love to hear from you!

Apply now to join a dynamic team committed to excellence.

If you receive suspicious outreach claiming to be from us, please contact us via the ManpowerGroup website.
